reference_implementations.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Classification
reference_implementations.tldr: Real-world datasets can contain competing models that provide conflicting predictions, highlighting the need to measure predictive multiplicity in model development.

reference_implementations.title: Temporal Supervised Contrastive Learning for Modeling Patient Risk Progression
reference_implementations.tldr: A supervised contrastive learning framework learns time series embeddings with properties ensuring similar outcomes cluster together, adjacent time steps remain close, and dissimilar features are separated, outperforming baselines in clinical prediction tasks.
